name: LGMS
recent: LGMS 近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动公告，包括独立董事 Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon 和 Dr Lim Pang Kiam 的增持，以及执行董事 Miss Goh Soon Sei 与董事经理 Mr Fong Choong Fook 在闭门期前的交易意向申报。公司也出现董事会成员变动，包括 Mr Yo Hayashi、Mr Toshio Kanki 和 Mr Tan Pek Loon 的职位调整。新闻方面，公司聚焦 AI 网络安全解决方案，并将在马来西亚举办网络安全领袖会议。
notable: 独立董事 Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日以每股 RM0.490 增持 20,000 股普通股。
非独立非执行董事 Dr Lim Pang Kiam 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日以每股 RM0.510 增持 100,000 股普通股。
公司出现董事会成员变动，涉及 Mr Yo Hayashi、Mr Toshio Kanki 和 Mr Tan Pek Loon。
risks: 多名董事及大股东在闭门期前申报交易意向，包括执行董事 Miss Goh Soon Sei 和董事经理 Mr Fong Choong Fook。
董事及大股东近期有多次持股变动，可能涉及股权结构变化。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 MYR 10,068,000，环比下降 7.3%，同比微增 0.4%；净利为 MYR 1,748,000，环比下降 20.5%，同比下降 13.7%；净利率为 17.4%，低于上一季度的 20.2%。

recent_en: LGMS has recently seen several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including acquisitions by independent directors Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon and Dr Lim Pang Kiam, as well as intentions to deal during closed period by Executive Director Miss Goh Soon Sei and Managing Director Mr Fong Choong Fook. There were also boardroom changes involving Mr Yo Hayashi, Mr Toshio Kanki and Mr Tan Pek Loon. In the news, the company is focusing on AI-powered cybersecurity solutions and will convene Malaysia's cyber leaders.
notable_en: Independent Director Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon acquired 20,000 ordinary shares at RM0.490 per share on 23 Oct 2026.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Dr Lim Pang Kiam acquired 100,000 ordinary shares at RM0.510 per share on 29 Sep 2026.
There were boardroom changes involving Mr Yo Hayashi, Mr Toshio Kanki and Mr Tan Pek Loon.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders, including Executive Director Miss Goh Soon Sei and Managing Director Mr Fong Choong Fook, declared intentions to deal during the closed period.
There have been multiple changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests recently, which may involve changes in shareholding structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 10,068,000, down 7.3% QoQ and up 0.4% YoY; net income was MYR 1,748,000, down 20.5% QoQ and down 13.7% YoY; net margin was 17.4%, lower than 20.2% in the previous quarter.
